description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of various video content categories, comprising a total of 14 distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; rather, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of the pie, while the corresponding percentage values are displayed directly inside each segment. Moving clockwise from the top, the categories are presented as follows: Howto Style in green (9.7%), People Blogs in orange (17.2%), Music in light purple (2.3%), Autos Vehicles in red (4.8%), Pets Animals in green (3.9%), News Politics in orange (4.3%), Science Technology in blue (6.4%), Comedy in cyan (5.6%), Travel Events in yellow-green (4.6%), Gaming in grey (6.4%), Sports in pink (7.7%), Film Animation in brown (4.6%), Entertainment in light purple (13.9%), and Education in red (8.7%). The segments do not appear to be ordered in any particular sequence, such as by descending or ascending size, and none of the slices are visually emphasized, offset, or exploded.
